recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中一小群空泡胞質的上皮樣細胞周圍，有四顆胞質充滿紫紅色異染性顆粒、核圓的肥大細胞（含左側一顆游離者），多顆可見顆粒向外散出。
features: Small cohesive cluster of epithelioid cells with round nuclei and vacuolated blue cytoplasm
Four mast cells with round nuclei and cytoplasm filled with purple-red metachromatic granules, one isolated at left
Granules dispersed at the periphery of several mast cells, suggesting degranulation
Two small lymphocytes adjacent to the cluster
describe_en: Pleural fluid cytocentrifuge preparation shows a small cohesive cluster of epithelioid cells with round nuclei and vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm. Four mast cells with round nuclei and densely granulated purple-red cytoplasm surround the cluster, including one free-lying cell, and several show granules spilling at their periphery. Two small lymphocytes are also present. Findings demonstrate mast cells in pleural fluid; the epithelioid cluster should be characterized by immunocytochemistry.

ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented nuclei and fewer, larger granules, whereas mast cells have round central nuclei with abundant densely packed granules.
Eosinophil granules are uniform orange-pink and refractile, and the nucleus is bilobed.
Macrophages contain heterogeneous vacuoles and debris with a bean-shaped nucleus rather than uniform metachromatic granules.
